Name: HxW Cozy Outdoor Dining Area for PIF
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[size=4]Add this adorable outdoor space to your farmhouse, your cabin, or maybe even your [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28031]NEW BAKERY SHED[/url]? (Hint hint at other mod this was made for hehe)

This mod makes use of PIF to create a cozy outdoor dining area you can access via a decorative door in game. Just place the door on a wall, choose "Cozy Outdoor Dining Area" and presto change-o you have your new space to decorate and even grow crops in!

This room along with HxW Small Business Kitchen were made to be used with our new Bakery Shed as fun add ons, but they can absolutely be enjoyed on their own.[/size][size=4]
[/size][b] [img]https://i.imgur.com/cNjfrI3.png[/img]

[/b][size=4]Credit first and foremost to Hime, my wonderful friend whose art never ceases to inspire me to more modding madness. You bring so much fun into my life and I love you so much hehe <3[/size][size=4]

Thanks to my wonderful friends on discord who support me and my shenanigans - I love you all so much <3[/size]
[size=4] [img]https://i.imgur.com/WrSO1e5.png[/img]

[/size][b][size=5]Enjoy what Hime does? Support her on [url=https://www.patreon.com/Himetarts]Patreon[/url]﻿ and follow her on [url=https://twitter.com/himetarts]Twitter[/url] for previews!

Buy Wildflour a [url=https://ko-fi.com/wildflourmods]Kofi[/url]﻿ OR CHECK HER OUT NOW ON [url=https://www.twitch.tv/wildflourmods]TWITCH[/url]﻿! [/size][/b][i][size=4] [img]https://i.imgur.com/T0uVb7A.png[/img]

[/size][/i][size=3]This mod is for SDV 1.6 - it is not compatible with older versions of the game. [b]It is untested for mobile or multiplayer.[/b] though if all the same mods are installed, multiplayer should be fine. I cannot troubleshoot mobile; multiplayer your best bet is to try the SDV
modded game support discord channel as it is often too hard for me to diagnose the issue across multiplayer saves. [/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DhwwHA2.png[/img]
[size=4]
[b]This mod is currently in English, with more on the way we hope ![/b]

If you would like to translate this mod into another language, please reach out to me. If there is something missing from your translation version, please let me know! But also remember [u]translators are just volunteers[/u] and though I am eternally grateful for their work, they are not [u]required[/u] to do so and so there can be delays with updating translation files![/size]
